title: Rainbow Tagine Stew
description: A vibrant and flavorful vegetarian tagine stew made with a variety of colorful vegetables and spices.
instructions: Heat the light olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the rainbow bell peppers and cook until tender, about 5 minutes.
Add the Dutch potatoes, tagine spice mix, salt, and black pepper. Stir to combine.
Cook for an additional 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add the kissed lemon juice and stir to combine.
Reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, for 20 minutes, or until the potatoes are tender.
Stir in the fresh parsley and serve hot.
Serve hot, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
